bias.zh: 反弹 · MACD 上穿，测试 $300

read.en: Alphabet rose 1.8% on Nov 12 to $298.70, trading $293.80–302.56. It is above the rising 5-day ($290.5) and the 10-day ($286.3) and below the 30-day ($320.2), 100-day ($338.9) and 200-day ($338.7), all falling. MACD crossed above its signal on Nov 12, below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 9 ($278.06), and RSI is 42.3.
read.zh: Alphabet 11月12日上涨 1.8%，收于 $298.70，盘中区间 $293.80–302.56。股价位于上行的 5 日均线（$290.5）和 10 日均线（$286.3）上方，30 日（$320.2）、100 日（$338.9）和 200 日均线（$338.7）下方，三者均在下行。MACD 于 11月12日上穿信号线，在零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 自 11月9日起看涨（$278.06），RSI 为 42.3。

read.en: The close cleared the $294.1–296.5 resistance (Nov 9 and Nov 4 highs), now support; the $302.56 high poked above $300 but the close stayed under it. Resistance is $300–302.6, then $314.9 (Jul 23 low) and $320.2 (30-day). Support is $293.8–296.5, then $289.5–290.5 (5-day, Nov 11 low, Nov 6 high) and $283.4–286.3 (10-day). A close above $302.6 would target $315; below $293.8, $289.5–290.5.

s.en: Nov 12 low $293.80; Mar 9 low $294.1; Nov 9 high $296.33; Nov 4 high $296.5, cleared
